description: The seven event categories of AN-16-442 v8 section 6.1 (JHEP 11 (2017) 047 section 6), in the order of the AN; the discriminants are the MELA-normalized ones (as the AN's MELA-only categorization), so the starting working points are the AN ones: D_2jet > 1.043 - 460/(m4l + 634), D_WH > 0.951 or D_ZH > 0.9937, D_1jet > 0.697, MET > 100 GeV; the working points are optimized on MC in stage 4b.  Jets: pT > 30 GeV, |eta| < 4.7, cleaned from the selected leptons, the candidate's leptons and the selected FSR photons; b tags DeepJet medium (|eta| < 2.4); additional leptons: selected leptons outside the candidate.
